name: Asthma
definition: A chronic condition involving inflammation and narrowing of the airways.
symptoms: cough that may worsen at night or with triggers
effects: Can limit activity. A severe attack can sharply reduce airflow and needs urgent care.
treatments: urgent care for a severe attack
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.

name: Hypertension
definition: A condition in which blood pressure is persistently elevated.
symptoms: nosebleeds when pressure is very high
effects: Raises long-term risk of heart disease, stroke, kidney disease, and vision damage.
treatments: blood-pressure medicines chosen by a clinician
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.

name: Allergy
definition: An immune response to a substance that is usually harmless to most people.
symptoms: swelling or trouble breathing in a severe reaction
effects: Ranges from mild discomfort to anaphylaxis, which is a medical emergency.
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.

name: Type 2 diabetes
definition: A chronic condition in which the body does not use insulin well and blood glucose stays too high.
effects: Over time can damage eyes, kidneys, nerves, and blood vessels, and raise the risk of heart disease.
treatments: insulin when a clinician prescribes it
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.

name: Influenza
definition: A contagious respiratory infection caused by influenza viruses.
effects: Usually improves in about a week. Can lead to pneumonia and be severe in older adults, young children, and people with other illnesses.
treatments: antiviral medicine when a clinician starts it early
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.

name: Pneumonia
definition: An infection that inflames the air sacs of one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid.
effects: Can lower blood oxygen. Severe infection can spread and cause sepsis.
treatments: antibiotics when the cause is bacterial
antivirals or supportive care when the cause is viral
oxygen and hospital care when breathing is impaired
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.

name: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
definition: A long-term lung disease, often from smoking, that limits airflow and makes breathing harder.
symptoms: shortness of breath that worsens over time
effects: Limits daily activity. Flare-ups can cause severe breathlessness and need emergency care.
treatments: oxygen when a clinician prescribes it
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.

name: Osteoarthritis
definition: A joint disease in which protective cartilage wears down, most often in the knees, hips, hands, or spine.
effects: Pain and stiffness can limit walking, grip, and other daily tasks. This fixture entry is osteoarthritis, the most common form of arthritis.
treatments: pain relief such as acetaminophen or NSAIDs when appropriate
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.

name: Depression
definition: A mood disorder with a persistent low mood or loss of interest that interferes with daily life.
symptoms: low mood most of the day
effects: Impairs work, relationships, and self-care. Severe depression can include thoughts of self-harm and needs urgent help.
treatments: urgent help if there is risk of self-harm
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.

name: Coronary artery disease
definition: Narrowing of the arteries that supply the heart, usually from plaque, which reduces blood flow to heart muscle.
symptoms: chest pressure or pain with exertion
sometimes no symptoms until a serious event
effects: Can cause angina, heart attack, heart failure, and sudden cardiac arrest.
treatments: statins and other medicines a clinician prescribes
procedures such as stenting or bypass when indicated
source: Synthetic terminology fixture. Not an official UMLS record.
